name: aws_backend
description: This package provides AWS DynamoDB storage services for the Dart SLTT (Sign Language Translation Tool) system, optimized for serverless deployment with minimal cold start time.

scripts.build:linux: rm -f bootstrap && dart compile exe bin/bootstrap.dart -o bootstrap && chmod +x bootstrap
scripts.deploy:secondary:dev: npm run build && npx serverless deploy --config serverless-secondary-infra.yml --stage dev --aws-profile sltt-dart-dev
scripts.deploy:secondary:tst: npm run build && npx serverless deploy --config serverless-secondary-infra.yml --stage tst --aws-profile sltt-dart-dev
scripts.deploy:secondary:prod: npm run build && npx serverless deploy --config serverless-secondary-infra.yml --stage prod --aws-profile sltt-dart-prd
scripts.logs:secondary:dev: npx serverless logs --config serverless-secondary-infra.yml --function api --stage dev --aws-profile sltt-dart-dev --startTime 1h
scripts.logs:secondary:tst: npx serverless logs --config serverless-secondary-infra.yml --function api --stage tst --aws-profile sltt-dart-dev --startTime 1h
scripts.logs:secondary:prod: npx serverless logs --config serverless-secondary-infra.yml --function api --stage prod --aws-profile sltt-dart-prd --startTime 1h
scripts.info:secondary:dev: npx serverless info --config serverless-secondary-infra.yml --stage dev --aws-profile sltt-dart-dev
scripts.info:secondary:tst: npx serverless info --config serverless-secondary-infra.yml --stage tst --aws-profile sltt-dart-dev
scripts.info:secondary:prod: npx serverless info --config serverless-secondary-infra.yml --stage prod --aws-profile sltt-dart-prd
scripts.cloudfront-url:shared: aws cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name sltt-shared-infra-prd --query "Stacks[0].Outputs[?OutputKey=='MediaCloudFrontDomainName'].OutputValue" --output text --profile sltt-dart-prd
scripts.cloudfront:public-key-set-ssm:tst: aws ssm put-parameter --name /sltt/media/cloudfront/tst/MEDIA_CLOUDFRONT_PUBLIC_KEY --type String --value file://../../../public_key.pem --overwrite --profile sltt-dart-dev
scripts.cloudfront:private-key-set-ssm:tst: aws ssm put-parameter --name /sltt/media/cloudfront/tst/MEDIA_CLOUDFRONT_PRIVATE_KEY --type SecureString --value file://../../../private_key.pem --overwrite --profile sltt-dart-dev
scripts.cloudfront:public-key-set-ssm:dev: aws ssm put-parameter --name /sltt/media/cloudfront/dev/MEDIA_CLOUDFRONT_PUBLIC_KEY --type String --value file://../../../public_key.pem --overwrite --profile sltt-dart-dev
scripts.cloudfront:private-key-set-ssm:dev: aws ssm put-parameter --name /sltt/media/cloudfront/dev/MEDIA_CLOUDFRONT_PRIVATE_KEY --type SecureString --value file://../../../private_key.pem --overwrite --profile sltt-dart-dev
scripts.cloudfront:public-key-set-ssm:prd: aws ssm put-parameter --name /sltt/media/cloudfront/prd/MEDIA_CLOUDFRONT_PUBLIC_KEY --type String --value file://../../../public_key.pem --overwrite --profile sltt-dart-prd
scripts.cloudfront:private-key-set-ssm:prd: aws ssm put-parameter --name /sltt/media/cloudfront/prd/MEDIA_CLOUDFRONT_PRIVATE_KEY --type SecureString --value file://../../../private_key.pem --overwrite --profile sltt-dart-prd
